sample.attemptPolicy: Latest attempt only; earlier attempts are not included

definitions.elapsedSeconds: Original run created_at to last executed job completed_at; reruns include delay before rerun
definitions.initialSchedulingSeconds: Run created_at to first executed job started_at
definitions.queueSeconds: Job created_at to started_at; includes dependency and runner wait, not an isolated runner queue
definitions.runnerMinutes: Sum of actual executed job seconds / 60; excludes skipped jobs; not invoice data
definitions.roundedJobMinutesEstimate: Sum of each executed job duration rounded up to minutes; excludes OS multipliers and prior attempts
definitions.failureRate: Failures / (successes + failures); cancelled, skipped, and neutral are separate conclusions
definitions.percentile: p90/p95 use nearest-rank; median (p50) averages the middle pair
definitions.cache: Explicit restore/miss markers by step time window; restoreRate includes exact and fallback restores; inaccessible or unobserved logs excluded
definitions.criticalPath: lastCompletedJob identifies the observed tail, not an inferred workflow DAG
definitions.attemptElapsedSeconds: Latest attempt run_started_at to last executed job completed_at; excludes delay before rerun

cacheEvidence.limitation: Raw logs are not retained. Legacy step attribution was ambiguous at second boundaries, so all baseline step cache outcomes are unknown. Job-scoped restore markers remain observed. Future CLI uses primary markers in explicit cache/setup steps; exact and fallback restores are combined.
